title: Span Spine Navigator: compact timeline, correlation lattice, rapid filters
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: design a compact, first-class request drill-down experience inside Redwood Console that surfaces correlated spans, high-cardinality correlation IDs, and rapid multi-facet filtering while remaining performant at 10k+ span sessions. The feature (Span Spine Navigator) combines a condensed timeline (the "spine") with a correlation lattice panel that exposes correlated IDs (trace id, request lineage, user/session ids) and a filter quick-bar for iterative exploration. This ticket covers low-fidelity through interactive prototype, engineering handoff notes, performance constraints, and accessibility considerations.
design_decisions: Use a single horizontal condensed timeline (spine) that can toggle between density modes (compact / normal / expanded) to support different SLO investigations
Group repeated spans from identical service & op pairs into collapsible micro-tiles to reduce visual noise and keep layout stable for large sessions
Expose a correlation lattice (adjacent panel) that ranks correlation keys by candidate entropy and cardinality rather than exposing raw hstore; this helps direct users to high-value correlation IDs
Implement filter quick-bar with keyboard-first controls (type to filter, / to focus) and multi-select chips that persist across drilldowns
Design deep-linking scheme for spine + filter state so shareable URLs capture timeline window, selected correlation keys, and focused span id
Prioritize incremental rendering for the spine using virtualized rows and WebGL-backed canvas painting for >5k spans to meet 100ms p95 interaction targets
tradeoffs_and_risks: Canvas-based rendering improves large-session perf but limits DOM-level accessibility; mitigation: mirrored ARIA layer for assistive tech
Grouping spans reduces immediate fidelity; mitigated by allowing single-span expand and timestamp micro-hover details
Ranking correlation keys adds computed complexity on the backend; requires a lightweight pre-aggregation hook in trace ingestion pipeline
Deep-linking long query strings may exceed URL length limits; fallback: short-id saved query stored server-side with friendly slug

prototype_notes: Compact mode default shows 4 service lanes, hover expands micro-timestamps and duration histogram
Correlation lattice computes 'signal score' = (cardinality_normalized * anomaly_score) to surface likely investigative keys
Filter quick-bar supports both exact match and fuzzy token match; pressing Enter pins a filter chip and updates the spine in <100ms in prototype
handoff_requirements: API: /v1/console/traces/:id/ranked-keys?window_start=...&window_end=... returns top 200 keys with stats
Render budget: p95 interaction <120ms for 5k spans; include sample trace payload (benchmarks CSV attached)
Accessibility checklist and keyboard interactions spec (attached as annotations)
